lines.zh: 我贴着地面小跑，翅膀半张着。
lines.en: I trot low to the ground with wings half open.

lines.zh: 我走两步就扑一下翅膀，忍不住。
lines.en: Every two steps I flap once; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛擦过苔藓，留下浅痕。
lines.en: My fuzz brushes the moss and leaves a faint line.

lines.zh: 我在树根间跳，像被风吹的纸片。
lines.en: I hop between roots like paper caught in wind.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚走，怕踩坏苔藓。
lines.en: I walk on tiptoe, afraid to crush the moss.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，翅膀扫起一点尘。
lines.en: I circle you, wings stirring a little dust.

lines.zh: 我走不快，但我会突然起飞。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, but I take off without warning.

lines.zh: 我的触角先探路，脚才跟上。
lines.en: My antennae probe ahead and my feet follow.

lines.zh: 我沿着篷车留下的车辙走。
lines.en: I walk along the ruts the caravan left.

lines.zh: 我停一下，抖掉翅膀上的粉。
lines.en: I pause to shake powder off my wings.

lines.zh: 我在低枝下走，特意收着翅膀。
lines.en: I pass under low branches with wings tucked in.

lines.zh: 我跟着灯笼的光，走一段歇一段。
lines.en: I follow lantern light, walking then resting.

lines.zh: 我踩到松针，脚下滑了一下。
lines.en: I step on pine needles and my foot slips.

lines.zh: 我走到你面前，然后忘了要做什么。
lines.en: I reach you, then forget what I came to do.

lines.zh: 我飞到篷车顶上，又落下来。
lines.en: I flit up onto the wagon roof, then drop back.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过灯罩，暖了一下。
lines.en: My wing brushes the lamp shade and warms.

lines.zh: 我停在枝上，翅膀慢慢合拢。
lines.en: I perch and my wings fold slowly shut.

lines.zh: 我用前脚擦脸，像在洗脸。
lines.en: I wipe my face with a front leg, like washing.

lines.zh: 我哼一小段，只有三个音。
lines.en: I hum a short bit, only three notes.

lines.zh: 风吹过我的绒毛，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Wind crosses my fuzz and I shiver.

lines.zh: 我把触角转向最亮的地方。
lines.en: I turn my antennae toward the brightest spot.

lines.zh: 我在灯下坐着，看粉尘飘。
lines.en: I sit by the lamp and watch dust drift.

lines.zh: 我偶尔叫一声，是叫给自己听的。
lines.en: I chirp now and then, for my own ears.

lines.zh: 我收着翅膀，怕被人看见花纹。
lines.en: I keep my wings closed so no one sees the pattern.

lines.zh: 我抱着自己的肚子打盹。
lines.en: I doze off hugging my own belly.

lines.zh: 我静下来时，像一片灰白的叶子。
lines.en: Still, I look like a gray-white leaf.

lines.zh: 我把脚缩起来，只留一点重量在枝上。
lines.en: I tuck my feet, leaving only a little weight on the branch.

lines.zh: 我听见篷车的木轮声，可这里是森林。
lines.en: I hear caravan wheels, though this is only forest.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，复眼里全是你的影子。
lines.en: I look up and my compound eyes fill with you.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，触角一前一后。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, antennae offset.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，怕那里面没有吃的。
lines.en: I watch your hands, afraid they hold no food.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我的翅膀先张开一半。
lines.en: You come close and my wings open halfway first.

lines.zh: 我眨不了眼，只能一直看。
lines.en: I cannot blink, so I just keep looking.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，就是那个总带面包的人。
lines.en: I know you: the one who always brings bread.

lines.zh: 我从枝上探头，翅膀抖了抖。
lines.en: I lean off the branch and my wings quiver.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我把脸藏到翅膀后。
lines.en: When you look, I hide my face behind a wing.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降到你肩头的高度。
lines.en: I descend slowly to your shoulder's height.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，然后叫了一声。
lines.en: I watch you a long while, then chirp once.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀破了个口，飞起来歪歪的。
lines.en: My wing has a tear and I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 我叫得很尖，自己都被吓到。
lines.en: My chirp turns shrill and startles even me.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片鳞粉，地上白了一小块。
lines.en: I shed scales and a small white patch marks the ground.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，把伤藏进绒毛里。
lines.en: I curl up and hide the wound in my fuzz.

lines.zh: 别打翅膀，那里薄得透光。
lines.en: Not the wings; that is my thinnest part.

lines.zh: 我被拍得贴在地上，慢慢撑起来。
lines.en: I am flattened to the ground and push myself up slowly.

lines.zh: 我疼得直抖，触角都垂下来了。
lines.en: I tremble with pain and my antennae droop.

lines.zh: 这一下让我飞不高了。
lines.en: That blow keeps me from flying high.

lines.zh: 我躲到叶子背面，还在发抖。
lines.en: I hide under a leaf, still shaking.

lines.zh: 我小声叫，像在跟谁告状。
lines.en: I chirp quietly, as if telling on someone.

lines.zh: 那味道甜，我的触角全竖起来。
lines.en: It smells sweet and my antennae stand straight up.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手飞了一圈。
lines.en: I fly one loop around your hand.

lines.zh: 是果酱吗？我在篷车里闻到过。
lines.en: Jam? I smelled that in the caravan once.

lines.zh: 我不敢落下来，只在你头顶打转。
lines.en: I dare not land and only circle above your head.

lines.zh: 你把东西放平，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: You set it flat, and only then do I approach.

lines.zh: 我舔一下，然后飞快退开。
lines.en: I lick once and retreat fast.

lines.zh: 这点甜够我记一整天。
lines.en: That much sweetness lasts me all day.

lines.zh: 我落在你手腕上，脚很轻。
lines.en: I land on your wrist, my feet very light.

lines.zh: 我吃得满脸都是，还不知道。
lines.en: I eat until my face is covered and do not notice.

lines.zh: 我跟着你飞，因为你手里还有。
lines.en: I fly after you because your hand still has some.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我掉了一把鳞粉。
lines.en: You bump me and a handful of scales falls off.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的肩，弹开又回来。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder, bounce off, and return.

lines.zh: 我被碰得歪了，翅膀乱扑两下。
lines.en: The touch tips me over and my wings flail twice.

lines.zh: 轻点，我的翅膀很薄。
lines.en: Gently, my wings are thin.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，你衣服上留下白粉。
lines.en: We collide and white powder marks your clothes.

lines.zh: 我撞到树枝，慢慢滑下来。
lines.en: I hit a branch and slide slowly down it.

lines.zh: 你别挥手，我会被扇得打转。
lines.en: Do not wave; I will be spun in circles.

lines.zh: 我落回你肩上，就当刚才没发生。
lines.en: I land back on your shoulder as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的一条腿有点麻。
lines.en: That knock left one of my legs numb.

lines.zh: 我小声叫了一下，算是抗议。
lines.en: I chirp softly, which counts as protest.

lines.zh: 我在夜里叫，等另一只回我。
lines.en: I call into the night, waiting for another to answer.

lines.zh: 我抖开翅膀，让花纹显出来。
lines.en: I spread my wings to show the pattern.

lines.zh: 我绕着她飞，飞成一个圈。
lines.en: I fly around her in a closed circle.

lines.zh: 我的鳞粉落在她触角上。
lines.en: My scales settle on her antennae.

lines.zh: 我们并排停在枝上，翅膀碰到一起。
lines.en: We perch side by side, wings touching.

lines.zh: 我送她一小片干叶，那是我最好的东西。
lines.en: I offer her a dry leaf fragment, my finest possession.

lines.zh: 她轻叫一声，我立刻应一句。
lines.en: She chirps and I chirp right after.

lines.zh: 我飞得比平时高，因为她在看。
lines.en: I fly higher than usual because she is watching.

lines.zh: 我们在灯下转了半宿，谁也没落下。
lines.en: We circle the lamp half the night, neither landing.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的粉留给她。
lines.en: I kept my brightest powder for her.

lines.zh: 我想把那颗种子抱起来，抱不动。
lines.en: I try to lift that seed and cannot.

lines.zh: 我用前脚抓了抓，什么也没抓住。
lines.en: I grab with my front legs and catch nothing.

lines.zh: 叶子太沉，我只能拖着走。
lines.en: The leaf is too heavy; I can only drag it.

lines.zh: 我把面包屑含在嘴里，飞不起来。
lines.en: With a crumb in my mouth I cannot take off.

lines.zh: 我试着捡线头，结果缠住了脚。
lines.en: I try to pick up a thread and get my foot tangled.

lines.zh: 地上亮的东西，我都想带走。
lines.en: Everything bright on the ground, I want to take.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根草，觉得自己很了不起。
lines.en: I pick up a blade of grass and feel very accomplished.

lines.zh: 我捡到一块碎壳，当成宝贝。
lines.en: I find a shell fragment and treat it as treasure.

lines.zh: 太重了，我只好放下，再飞走。
lines.en: Too heavy, so I drop it and fly off.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在树洞里，回头就忘了。
lines.en: I hide it in a tree hollow and forget by the way back.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我的触角转过去。
lines.en: Something moves and my antennae swing toward it.

lines.zh: 我看见一只虫，可我不想吃它。
lines.en: I see a bug, but I do not want to eat it.

lines.zh: 那边有光，我要去看看。
lines.en: There is light over there and I must see it.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那片花，全是蜜。
lines.en: I have my eye on that flower patch, full of nectar.

lines.zh: 有人走过去了，我记下方向。
lines.en: Someone walked past; I noted the direction.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，看它会不会回头。
lines.en: I chirp once to see if it turns.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最高的那根枝。
lines.en: I have picked the highest branch.

lines.zh: 风里有甜味，我朝那边飞。
lines.en: Sweetness rides the wind and I fly that way.

lines.zh: 我的目标是那块挂在窗上的布。
lines.en: My goal is the cloth hanging in the window.

lines.zh: 我找到你了，在你的帽子上停住。
lines.en: Found you, and I land on your hat.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膀快得看不见。
lines.en: I hover with wings too fast to see.

lines.zh: 我一点一点靠近，先绕两圈。
lines.en: I close in slowly, circling twice first.

lines.zh: 我在等它先动，我不喜欢被吓。
lines.en: I wait for it to move; I dislike being startled.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着草尖飞。
lines.en: I drop low and skim the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我停在它上方，只看着。
lines.en: I stop above it and only watch.

lines.zh: 我试着落下去，又抬起来。
lines.en: I try to descend, then lift again.

lines.zh: 我的影子在它身上晃来晃去。
lines.en: My shadow sways back and forth across it.

lines.zh: 它不动了，我就再近一点。
lines.en: It goes still, so I come a little nearer.

lines.zh: 我在算落点，风一直吹偏我。
lines.en: I calculate my landing while the wind keeps pushing me off.

lines.zh: 我最后落在旁边，不是它身上。
lines.en: I land beside it in the end, not on it.

lines.zh: 我撞它的头，用全身的力气。
lines.en: I ram its head with all my weight.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀扇它，粉尘扑了它一脸。
lines.en: I beat my wings and dust covers its face.

lines.zh: 我咬它一口，牙小得几乎没感觉。
lines.en: I bite it, my teeth so small it barely feels.

lines.zh: 我扑下去，然后又慌张地飞开。
lines.en: I dive at it, then fly off in a panic.

lines.zh: 我的攻击更像发脾气。
lines.en: My attack is more of a tantrum.

lines.zh: 我抓着它，脚爪扎进绒毛里。
lines.en: I grip it, claws sunk into its fur.

lines.zh: 它一挥，我就被打得翻了个身。
lines.en: One swipe from it flips me over.

lines.zh: 我叫着冲过去，声音比动作凶。
lines.en: I charge screaming, louder than my actual strike.

lines.zh: 我撞完就躲到你身后。
lines.en: I hit and then hide behind you.

lines.zh: 我打不过，可我还是打了。
lines.en: I cannot win, but I struck anyway.

lines.zh: 我从篷车的木箱里钻出来，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: I crawl from a caravan crate with soft new wings.

lines.zh: 我第一次张开翅膀，摔在草上。
lines.en: My first wing-spread ends in a fall onto grass.

lines.zh: 我出生时，闻到的全是松脂味。
lines.en: I was born to the smell of pine resin.

lines.zh: 我试了三次才飞起来。
lines.en: It took three tries before I could fly.

lines.zh: 我顶着一身湿粉，慢慢晾干。
lines.en: I wait, covered in damp powder, drying slowly.

lines.zh: 我叫了第一声，很轻，像纸响。
lines.en: My first chirp was faint, like paper rustling.

lines.zh: 我被放在枝上，就再没下来过。
lines.en: I was set on a branch and never came down.

lines.zh: 车辙把我带到了这里，然后车走了。
lines.en: The ruts brought me here, then the cart left.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看见的是篷布缝隙里的天。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to sky through a canvas seam.

lines.zh: 我出生在针叶林，那里松针很厚。
lines.en: I was born in taiga, where pine needles lie thick.

lines.zh: 火星沾到翅膀，我拼命扑，扑不灭。
lines.en: A spark catches my wing and I beat it hard without putting it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，翅膀折了一边。
lines.en: I drop from high up and one wing folds wrong.

lines.zh: 水粘住我的粉，我怎么也飞不起来。
lines.en: Water glues my powder down and I cannot lift off.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出很远，粉全散了。
lines.en: The blast throws me far and my powder scatters.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的翅膜，留下一道口子。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing membrane and leaves a slit.

lines.zh: 药水味冲得我头晕，翅膀乱了拍子。
lines.en: The potion fumes make me dizzy and my wingbeat stumbles.

lines.zh: 我饿得飞不动，只能趴在枝上。
lines.en: Too hungry to fly, I can only lie on the branch.

lines.zh: 雷声把我震落，我在草里缩了很久。
lines.en: Thunder knocks me down and I huddle in the grass a long while.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我的翅膀白扑了。
lines.en: The void has no air and my wings beat for nothing.
